result.instructions: Tools for Billdu, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are still unpaid, and how old are they?"; "Create a client called ACME Ltd. in New York with the e-mail acme@example.com."; "List our products and their prices.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Billdu data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run billdu_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run billdu_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run billdu_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. billdu_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: billdu_list_clients
tools.title: List clients
tools.description: List the clients (customers) of the Billdu business, with their address, VAT id and linked documents. Billdu API: GET /clients.

tools.name: billdu_get_client
tools.title: Get a client
tools.description: Get one client by id, with contact, address, tax ids and linked documents. Billdu API: GET /clients/{id}.

client_id.description: The id from a list call.

tools.name: billdu_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List the products and services in the Billdu catalogue with name, price and tax rate. Billdu API: GET /products.

tools.name: billdu_get_product
tools.title: Get a product
tools.description: Get one product or service by id. Billdu API: GET /products/{id}.

product_id.description: The id from a list call.

tools.name: billdu_list_documents
tools.title: List documents
tools.description: List invoices, orders, proformas, estimates and credit notes, optionally one type. Billdu API: GET /documents?type=.

tools.name: billdu_get_document
tools.title: Get a document
tools.description: Get one invoice, order, proforma, estimate or credit note by id, with its items, totals and status. Billdu API: GET /documents/{id}.

document_id.description: The id from a list call.

tools.name: billdu_create_client
tools.title: Create a client
tools.description: Create a new client (customer) in the Billdu business. Use only the fields the user gave. Billdu API: POST /clients.

fullname.description: Contact person's full name, when there is no company.

country.description: Country code, e.g. US or DE.

tools.name: billdu_send_document
tools.title: Send a document by e-mail
tools.description: E-mail an existing invoice or other document to the given recipients, from the Billdu account. This contacts real people: call it only after the user confirms the recipients and the message. Billdu API: POST /documents/{id}/send.

document_id.description: The id from a list call.

prompts.name: create_a_client_after_a_duplicate_check
prompts.title: Create a client after a duplicate check

prompts.description: Open the document to check its items and total. E-mail it only after the user confirms the recipients and the message.

prompts.title: Check products and prices
prompts.description: List the products and services with their names, prices and tax rates. Open one to read its details.
